text: oh u know what i didnt even look at those settings. thanks. but regardless, still stands about what i said with rolling over, should just let the car roll over
resolution: Reworked the vehicle-lab rollover so it plays out instead of stopping/resetting. Root cause was two-fold: (1) on a tip the car latched 'flipped', cut all controls, and waited for a manual R/reset — the sim froze; (2) the 2.6 trip kick couldn't clear the on-its-side energy peak (±π/2), so the body only half-leaned ~33° and snapped back each frame, flickering flipped on/off — exactly the 'it says I rolled over and I didn't' over-sensitivity. Fix in game/driving/index.ts: the trip kick now clears the peak (sqrt(2·rolloverGravity·0.7)·1.15) so the car genuinely goes over onto its roof; the airborne tumble runs on light damping (0.12) so it carries through rather than stalling; and the moment it comes to rest inverted it self-rights (eases roll back to 0) and restores control. No freeze, no reset, no mandatory keypress. Verified by sim across all 9 styles: tippy bodies go fully over (179°) and recover in ~2s, sports/fire_truck still slide instead of tipping; handling.test.ts 7/7 green. Banner updated to 'ROLLED OVER — recovering…'. NOTE for the user: the default sedan still trips on a hard turn because its baseline cgHeight (0.95) sits above the tip line — that's a feel-table tuning dial (WEIGHT/ROLLOVER: cg height / lat g in the lab), left untouched per your call to handle settings yourself.
